Docs.summary: The classes in this package are used for development of accessibility service that provide alternative or augmented feedback to the user.

remarks.para: Derive from to implement an accessibility service. Describe its event types, feedback, and capabilities with and the service metadata.

The namespace also provides controllers for magnification, the soft keyboard, fingerprint gestures, touch interaction, and supported Braille displays. describes touch gestures for a service to dispatch, and provides text editing operations for accessibility services.
